# E0504: reason on an arm that isn't a catch-all

Only a catch-all arm, `_` or a binding, gives a reason with `because`, saying why dropping every error is right. Delete the reason from this arm.

- Rule: [`effects.reasons-only-on-catch-alls`](../../reference/12-effects.md#effects.reasons-only-on-catch-alls)
- Reported at: the reason.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0504:7
type ParseError = | Empty | NotANumber

fn parse(text: str) -> i64 / raise<ParseError> { raise NotANumber }

fn count(text: str) -> i64 {
  try parse(text) catch {
    Empty because "an empty line counts zero" => 0
    NotANumber => 1
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type ParseError = | Empty | NotANumber

fn parse(text: str) -> i64 / raise<ParseError> { raise NotANumber }

fn count(text: str) -> i64 {
  try parse(text) catch {
    Empty => 0
    NotANumber => 1
  }
}
```
